verdict.rationale: HubSpot's Workflows product explicitly supports building trigger-based automations ('Create workflows in HubSpot to automate your processes') that update CRM records, and the platform's broader capabilities (contact/custom object creation via API, deduplication, task/notification-related CRM actions) corroborate that workflows can update records and trigger actions. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation snippet detailing task-creation or notification-sending actions within a workflow, and no independent/hands-on account of building such a workflow.
